Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable:--blameless, unrebukeable.
BiblicalUsage: Paul tells Timothy a bishop must be blameless, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach. The word names the man who cannot be seized upon, no handle for an accuser to grab.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for a leader no one can lay hold of carries no system of its own; its standard is Paul's, that a bishop's life must give his accusers nothing to grip.
